definitions.explanation: The party who lends money or rents out property, as named in a loan or rental contract. In housing, the owner who rents out a room or house.

examples.japanese: {貸主|かしぬし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: To pay the rent to the landlord.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{貸主|かしぬし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{借主|かりぬし}→借主：31142_karinushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The contract shows the names of the lessor and the lessee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貸主|かしぬし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: When moving out, you must notify the landlord at least a month in advance.

notes:
⟦{貸|か}す→貸す：00537_kasu⟧ (to lend) + ⟦{主|ぬし}→主：30578_nushi⟧ (owner, master). A contract and real-estate term; in conversation people say ⟦{大家|おおや}さん→大家さん：26895_ooyasan⟧ for a landlord.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貸主|かしぬし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{借主|かりぬし}→借主：31142_karinushi⟧: lessor and lessee
- {貸主|かしぬし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{承諾|しょうだく}→承諾：12778_shoudaku⟧: the landlord's consent
- {貸主|かしぬし}⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧: paid by the landlord

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{借主|かりぬし}→借主：31142_karinushi⟧: borrower, tenant — the opposite party
- ⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧: landlord — the everyday word, for housing only
- ⟦{家主|やぬし}→家主：04079_yanushi⟧: owner of a rented house
